database_supporting_records.note: Database rows were used as cross-checks; final activity rows are sourced from primary XML/PDF prose, figure captions, and the OOXML supplement table.

quality_controls.detail: Every row has endpoint, raw value, unit or qualitative-unit rationale, target, assay conditions, and source locator.
No database-only row is treated as primary activity evidence; database rows are cross-references only.
Target labels are species/strain labels, not sentence fragments.
The true DOCX supplement was parsed via OOXML; repeated landing .bin assets are HTML captures and add no distinct assay table.

nonblocking_material_limitations.impact: Exact bar heights for biofilm, infection survival, catheter counts, and liposome leakage are not represented as numeric values; source-supported qualitative/statistical conclusions are retained with figure locators.

adjudication_note: Worker-2 recovered MIC, salt-condition MIC, biofilm, infection-survival, catheter, and cytotoxicity rows from local XML/PDF/DOCX sources after the initial parser emitted zero activity records.
